title: Per-tenant stratified slice curation with recency-weighted hard-negative augmentation for quant validation
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Create a repeatable curation and sampling strategy for producing per-tenant / per-domain calibration slices used by FP8 and INT8 quantization workflows. The goal is to generate calibration bundles that reflect production distribution (including rare but high-impact examples), preserve temporal recency, and explicitly include hard negatives for accuracy-sensitive customers.
background: Current calibration packs are globally sampled and do not consistently capture tenant-specific skew or recent behavioral shifts. This leads to variance in post-quantization accuracy across tenants and domains. We need a pipeline-level approach that produces compact, representative per-tenant slices suitable for offline calibration runs and CI validation against golden FP16 baselines.
objectives: 1) Define a reproducible per-tenant sampling algorithm that balances head vs tail examples, recency, and difficulty. 2) Produce calibration slices of configurable size (e.g., 500-5k prompts) with deterministic seeding. 3) Add an augmentation stage to include hard negatives (contradictory outputs, hallucination-prone prompts). 4) Integrate the slices into quant calibration workflows and the CI accuracy validation harness.
proposed_approach: - Compute tenant/domain fingerprints from anonymized request metadata and prompt clusters. - Stratify by cohort buckets: top-traffic templates, medium-tail variants, and rare long-tail prompts. - Apply a recency weight (exponential decay) to increase probability of recent examples. - Inject hard negatives by mining outputs that previously diverged between FP16 and INT8 runs or that failed QA checks. - Enforce per-tenant quotas and privacy safeties (no PII, opt-outs respected). - Export slices as deterministic tarballs with metadata for downstream calibration and CI.
data_schema: Each slice is a newline-delimited JSONL artifact with fields: 'prompt_id', 'anonymized_prompt_hash', 'domain', 'tenant_id_hash', 'timestamp', 'context_tokens', 'expected_output_hash', 'difficulty_label'. All fields are pre-hashed/anonymized; raw text is not included in per-tenant artifacts unless the tenant opts in.
sampling_algorithm: 1) Aggregate last N days of production logs per tenant (N configurable). 2) Cluster prompts by semantic fingerprint (MinHash + embedding nearest neighbors). 3) Assign cluster-level score = alpha * normalized_frequency + beta * recency_weight + gamma * difficulty_score. 4) Sample deterministically using weighted reservoir sampling to produce target slice size. 5) Post-process: add top-K hard negatives, ensure max-per-cluster cap, and preserve at least 10% tail examples.
recency_weight_formula: recency_weight = exp(-lambda * age_days). Default lambda=0.03 (half-life ~23 days); tunable per-customer.
hard_negative_strategy: Hard negatives are selected from: a) historical FP16 vs quant divergence logs b) QA-flagged hallucinations c) synthetically-generated paraphrase perturbations that flip expected outputs. Mark items with difficulty_label 'hard' so validation harness can stratify metrics.
privacy_and_compliance: - Tenant identifiers are hashed with per-customer salt. - Remove prompts flagged as PII via existing detector. - For regulated tenants, only a metadata-only slice (no prompt text) is exported unless opt-in. - Access controls enforced via RBAC for calibration artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: - Per-tenant slice generator pipeline added to infra and runnable on sample tenants. - Deterministic slices for same seed and window. - Quant CI: INT8 and FP8 runs on produced slices yield median accuracy delta < 0.8% vs FP16 on held-out canonical metrics across 80% of tenants. - Slice sizes configurable and validated (500, 2k, 5k). - Documentation and runbook published in Confluence.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overfitting calibration to recent anomalies => Mitigation: retain a small fixed historical sample (10%)
Risk: Too many hard negatives skew calibration => Mitigation: cap hard negatives at 15% of slice
Risk: Privacy leakage via prompt artifacts => Mitigation: aggressive hashing + PII filters + opt-outs
Risk: Determinism broken by downstream nondeterministic clustering => Mitigation: store cluster seeds and versioned fingerprinting code
test_plan: - Unit tests for scoring and reservoir sampler. - Integration job that generates slices for 10 pilot tenants and runs FP16/INT8/FP8 calibration + evaluation. - Canary: compare metrics baseline and fail if median_accuracy_delta > 1.5% for pilot cluster. - Add nightly job to regen slices and check checksum stability.
rollout_plan: 1) Pilot 10 low-risk tenants (2 weeks). 2) Expand to 100 tenants with automated alerts (1 month). 3) Full internal rollout and use for all quant CI (after 6 weeks). Each phase gated by acceptance criteria and monitored metrics.
